question: Where’s the closest restaurant on the journey from University of the Rockies, Denver, CO toward Molly Brown Summer House, Denver, CO?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'restaurant' ORDER BY ST_Distance( geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%University of the Rockies%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Denver%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Molly Brown Summer House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Denver%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
